sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:165971
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 14655 of 2023

Applicant :- Ravi @ Ravi Kumar
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Narendra Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Satendra Singh
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Case called out.
None appeared on behalf of the informant.
However, learned AGA for the State is present.

2. Heard Sri Narendra Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S.B. Maurya, learned AGA-I for the State.
3. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 551 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kuraoli,
District Mainpuri during pendency of the trial.
4. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and his family members including husband of the deceased i.e. brother of the applicant and according to the FIR marriage of the brother of the applicant was performed with the deceased on 18.02.2022 and after marriage applicant and his family members tortured her for demand of dowry and on 15.11.2022 informant received an information that his daughter i.e. deceased has died.
Ravi @ Ravi Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8243560/
1 5.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is Devar of the deceased and entire allegation of demand of dowry and torture made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and applicant is having no concern with the family affairs of the deceased and due to the dispute with her husband deceased committed suicide and post mortem report of the deceased suggests that deceased died due to hanging.
6.
He further submits that bail applications of father-in-law Lal Singh and mother-in-law Manju Devi of the deceased have been allowed by this Court.
He produced the bail orders of the in-laws of the deceased during the course of argument, which are taken on record and marked as 'A'.
He further submits that case of applicant is even on better footing than the in-laws, therefore, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
7. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the argument on facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. Considering the fact that applicant is Devar of the deceased and deceased died due to hanging and bail application of father-in-law and mother-in-law have been allowed by this Court and case of applicant is even on better footing than the in-laws, in my view, applicant is also entitled to be released on bail.
10. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

11. Let the applicant - Ravi @ Ravi Kumar be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
12.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

13. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
